text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, we're volunteering to play<n>with some
children at a nearby<n>kindergarten.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek deftly chases the<n>children around the
playground, until...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She accidently hits her head full force<n>on the
playground equipment and<n>sinks to the ground.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. I was seeing stars right<n>when I smacked
my head...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But after that, my mind actually felt<n>surprisingly
clear. I had a really easy<n>time running for some
reason.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe... Maybe I can use this<n>to my
advantage in races?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hey, can we go back to the academy<n>and test it
out?
choice_data_list: You're going to hit your head again?!
You're going to hit your head again?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! No, no! I just want to try<n>running again.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If all goes well, maybe I can make<n>you smile even
wider! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek appears to have figured<n>something out
by hitting her head, and<n>her running noticeably
improves!
